did: A template in Studio can now be previewed: code cuts its sample episode down to 15 to 30 seconds, the intro, the brand slides and the first section, and home's render worker can record that cut as a short video from the sample alone. The preview is placed in the promises ledger: a preview asked for is made or says why it failed, and home keeps at most one per template, gone after a day. Home's routes and prune are built in the server's pull request, and the phone's Preview button is built but waits for those routes to reach main.

calls.title: Home's keeping of previews is a promise about what it keeps
options: A promise about what home keeps, and for how long
calls.why: The owner's words were about keeping: newest per template only, gone 24 hours after it is made.
calls.undo: Change PV2's kind in the ledger, as an amendment.

left: The phone's Preview button (#2778) stays a draft until home serves its routes and the route snapshot reaches main; its contract lands with it.
The two preview promises move to holding once the server's pull request is on main, naming its tests; the size bound has no test yet, filed on the server.
Playoff Delta's templates can't be previewed until they have a sample narration that passes its fact check.
The video itself doesn't mark it is a preview of sample data; only its title says so. That needs a burn-in design.
The discard-sites entry for the preview prune waits on the prune reaching main.
